generationMode: built-in image_gen, one generated photo prompt per section, optimized with cwebp q82

brandDirection.blend: Human housing warmth with soft-brutalist Fairlend structure: hard rules, squared CTAs, dark-green rails, permit/document stamps, paper grain, blueprint fields, and restrained terracotta/civic-blue accents.

constraints.photoRule: Exactly one photographic asset per page section. Do not add extra thumbnails, collage strips, secondary photos, or baked-in photo panels inside section UI.
constraints.photoTreatment: Clear, inspectable GTA missing-middle housing and financing-review imagery with warm paper-compatible grade. No readable text, logos, watermarks, UI, or blueprint overlays inside the photo assets.
constraints.uiTreatment: Build diagrams, stamps, rails, checklists, labels, and capital/draw structures with code or SVG assets so the page remains editable.

sections.title: Multiplex Financing in the GTA
sections.purpose: Match search intent and immediately communicate financing relevance.

photo.alt: Modern GTA multiplex building on a quiet residential street.
photo.usageNotes: Hero image. Use as one large image with a readable safe area for the headline and squared CTAs; avoid additional hero thumbnails.

photo.alt: Builder reviewing plans beside a GTA multiplex construction site.
photo.usageNotes: Pair with project-type list or grid. Keep this as the only photo in the section; render project cards as code.

sections.title: What counts as a multiplex?
sections.purpose: Educate early-stage borrowers and align terminology.

photo.alt: Completed missing-middle multiplex facade with multiple unit entries.
photo.usageNotes: Use as the single definition photo with code-rendered labels for triplex, fourplex, six-unit, and garden-suite examples.

sections.title: Why multiplex financing is hard
sections.purpose: Name the pain points that make Fairlend relevant.

photo.alt: Partially renovated GTA multiplex construction site with open framing.
photo.usageNotes: Use as one atmospheric problem photo with challenge rows rendered separately as stamped code elements.

photo.alt: Capital-planning desk with drawings, calculator, and multiplex financing documents.
photo.usageNotes: Embed as the only photo next to a code-rendered capital-stack diagram. Do not use extra document thumbnails.

photo.alt: Multiplex construction framing site with organized building materials.
photo.usageNotes: Use as the single construction progress photo. Render draw timeline, inspection nodes, and liquidity gap as code/SVG overlays or adjacent UI.

sections.title: Readiness before promises
sections.purpose: Connect MLI Select considerations to document readiness without implying qualification.

photo.alt: Financing readiness desk with architectural drawings and review documents.
photo.usageNotes: Use as one unbroken readiness photo. Render checklist rows, caution copy, and MLI disclaimer in accessible HTML.

sections.title: Ready to assess your multiplex project?
sections.purpose: Close with project examples, process clarity, and intake CTA.

photo.alt: Completed GTA multiplex building with warm residential lighting.
photo.usageNotes: Use as the final single housing proof photo beside process steps and CTA. Do not add a footer photo collage.

blueprintGrid.usage: Subtle section backgrounds, side rails, and blueprint fields.

paperGrain.usage: Warm paper texture overlay for public Fairlend surfaces.

fairlendMonogram.usage: Local page monogram or side-rail brand mark.

reviewStamp.usage: Review/readiness stamp motif. Decorative; keep actual claims in HTML text.

permitStamp.usage: Permit-status motif for definition, hard-financing, and readiness sections.

warningTriangle.usage: Caution marker for disclaimers and non-guarantee copy.

qa.verificationCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('public/assets/fairlend-multiplex-gta/manifest.json','utf8')); if(m.sections.length!==8) throw new Error('expected 8 sections'); for(const s of m.sections){ if(!s.photo?.path) throw new Error('missing photo '+s.section); const p='public'+s.photo.path; if(!fs.existsSync(p)) throw new Error('missing file '+p); } console.log('ok', m.sections.length);"
qa.manualVisualCheck: Contact sheet inspected after generation; each canonical section has one primary photographic asset and no thumbnail/collage photo composition.
